ProgramUnit.PACK_DESK_overridden:ProgramUnitText:
PACKAGE pks IS
 SUBTYPE t_code IS varchar2(4);
 g_code varchar2(6);
 TYPE t_rec IS RECORD (code varchar2(7), note varchar2(30));
 g_rec t_rec;
 TYPE t_tab IS TABLE OF t_rec INDEX BY PLS_INTEGER;
 g_tab t_tab;
 TYPE t_out IS RECORD (inner t_rec);
 g_out t_out;
 PROCEDURE keep;
 FUNCTION f(p_id number) RETURN varchar2;
END;

PACKAGE BODY pks IS
 PROCEDURE keep IS
 BEGIN
 SELECT status INTO g_code FROM orders WHERE order_id = 1;
 END;
 FUNCTION f(p_id number) RETURN varchar2 IS
 BEGIN
 RETURN NULL;
 END;
END;

PROCEDURE use_pks IS
 c pks.t_code;
 a pks.g_code%TYPE;
 r pks.t_rec;
 f pks.g_rec.code%TYPE;
 x pack_lib_pk.t_code;
BEGIN
 SELECT status INTO c FROM orders WHERE order_id = 1;
 SELECT status INTO a FROM orders WHERE order_id = 1;
 SELECT status INTO pks.g_code FROM orders WHERE order_id = 1;
 FOR o IN (SELECT status FROM orders) LOOP
 pks.g_code := o.status;
 END LOOP;
 SELECT status INTO r.code FROM orders WHERE order_id = 1;
 SELECT status, note INTO r FROM orders WHERE order_id = 1;
 SELECT status INTO pks.g_rec.code FROM orders WHERE order_id = 1;
 SELECT status INTO pks.g_rec.note FROM orders WHERE order_id = 1;
 SELECT status INTO f FROM orders WHERE order_id = 1;
 SELECT status INTO pks.g_tab(1).code FROM orders WHERE order_id = 1;
 SELECT status, note BULK COLLECT INTO pks.g_tab FROM orders;
 SELECT status INTO pks.g_out.inner.code FROM orders WHERE order_id = 1;
 IF pks.g_tab(1).code = pks.f(1) THEN
 NULL;
 END IF;
 SELECT status INTO x FROM orders WHERE order_id = 1;
END;
